page.layout: One printed page. A single text column with two inline syllogism diagrams, each with section letters (A, B, C) in the right margin. Catchword "In" at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.l: Cedo exemplum primæ figuræ. Efto pofita
quæstio, An sobrietas fit laudabilis, Sobrietas
beatur medium ex genere minoris, Virtus.
Nam genus Subiecti quæsitum est, Virtus:que
inter duo quæstionis extrema ita interiici-
tur,vt in propositione sit subiectum attribu-
autem generi conuenit , etiam speciei conue-
niat necesse est.Itaque ad hunc locū illud quo-
que pertinet : Quæ mulier lac habet,ea pepe-
mum collocatur? Cùm de ambobus extremis

page.notes: Long s (s) and u/v/i/j normalised as instructed. Printed hyphens at line ends kept. Right margin letters A, B, C are section letters, placed beside the diagram lines they stand against. Diagram levels and the numbers 1–4 are read from the layout of the two syllogism displays and are approximate. Catchword "In" is the start of the next page.
